title: Transitivity of Bounded Reachability
statement: Fix an input word $y$ and a bound $W\in\mathbb{N}$. For the specified machine and oracle, suppose there is a finite run from configuration $a$ to $b$ and a finite run from $b$ to $c$, such that at every time before each run's endpoint the work-tape head lies between $-1$ and $W$, inclusive. Then there is a finite run from $a$ to $c$ with the same head-position bounds at every time before its endpoint.
hypotheses_covered: A run from $a$ to $b$ whose pre-endpoint work-tape head positions lie in $[-1,W]$
A run from $b$ to $c$ whose pre-endpoint work-tape head positions lie in $[-1,W]$
